criteria: Route fit; evidence production; feasibility; authority; reversibility
evidence_and_authority: Triangulation across configuration snapshots, issue records, meeting notes, policy documents and illustrative interviews, including discrepant evidence.
assumptions_and_risks: Synthetic case, selective records, bounded period and dependence on the declared case boundary.
conditional_commitment: Define the case, period and evidence chain before collecting multiple source types; preserve discrepant evidence.
early_test: Test whether one adoption episode can be reconstructed across at least three independent source types.
reopening_trigger: Failed early evidence reopens Design Gate; unavailable or unauthorised evidence reopens Problem or Evidence Gate.
